facts.fact: A Ministry of Health eHealth adviser (Claudel Sebaganwa) said at the Africa HealthTech Summit on 1 October 2026 that from the moment a patient enters a clinical setting all data is recorded electronically, the record covering patients, diseases, medicines, laboratory services and pharmacies; no facility count or share is given.

systems.system: community health worker electronic medical record
systems.country_label: electronic medical record used by community health workers
systems.tiers: community health workers; records all households; integrated with the National Health Intelligence Centre

note: The document does not separate the community health workers' record from the clinical one by name; the adviser describes both under 'an electronic medical record', so the emr fact rests on his clinical-settings sentence only.
